Adjusted feed/sitemap behavior and article/source handling.

Command reports failed sources and returns a command error rather than silently succeeding on provider failures.

Added REST endpoints and health routes while preserving legacy routes and admin.
Working sample database differs from base. Export contains a rebuilt, free-page-cleaned snapshot with identical logical table data; no private user credentials/sessions ship.
Added optional production Redis client dependency.
Updated/pinned backend dependencies including DRF, CORS and python-dotenv.
